newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Lippo Securities to split stock price.
newsitem.headline: Lippo Securities to split stock price.

text.p: Indonesia's large brokerage firm PT Lippo Securities said on Monday it planned to split the nominal value of its stock price to 500 rupiah from the current 1,000 rupiah per share.
"We plan to advertise the announcement of the stock split in some local newspapers soon," a Lippo Securities official, who declined to be named, said.
The official said retailer PT Multipolar Corp., which also belongs to the Lippo Group, was also likely to split its nominal stock price in the near-term.
She did not give further details.
Lippo Securities was among the most actively traded shares in afternoon trading on Monday. It rose 200 rupiah to 2,850 rupiah.
